about.title: One connected rental journey.
about.text: Discover verified listings, apply, schedule viewings, agree on terms and complete a rental agreement without scattering important details across chats and paper records.

help.text: The dashboard keeps renter and owner actions organized around simple next steps, from finding a home through completing an agreement.

living.title: A rental score built for how Gilgit actually feels to live in.
living.text: Instead of judging a home only by rent and photos, the score surfaces winter readiness, utilities and access conditions that matter locally.
living.transparentTitle: See exactly where the score comes from.
living.transparentText: The score is rule-based, not a black-box AI model. Every point maps to a specific property condition.

factor.heating: Whether the property provides heating for Gilgit winters.

factor.electricityBackup: Backup electricity support when the grid is unavailable.

factor.roadAccess: Ease of reaching the property and nearby routes.
factor.winterAccessible: Whether the property remains reasonably accessible in winter.

ed.text: Complete one clear section at a time. Required fields are labelled, optional details can be skipped, and your listing stays a draft until you submit it for admin review.
ed.lockedStep: Save the draft before opening this step

step.basicsText: Give renters a clear first impression of the property.
step.pricingText: Explain the monthly cost, deposit and move-in timing.
step.detailsText: Describe the physical setup and who the home suits.
step.locationText: Describe the area, then pin the exact spot on the map.
step.amenitiesText: Select only the facilities that are genuinely available.
step.livingText: Capture the Gilgit-specific conditions that affect everyday living.
step.imagesText: Add at least three clear photos and choose one cover image.
step.reviewText: Check the listing before sending it to the admin review queue.
step.roomsText: Room types, nightly prices and check-in times

notice.basics: Use a specific title and a useful description. Renters should understand what the property is before they open the listing.
notice.pricing: Enter amounts in Pakistani rupees. The security deposit can be zero, and negotiable rent simply tells renters that discussion is possible.
notice.details: These details help renters compare properties. Use 0 bedrooms for hostel beds or room-style listings when a separate bedroom count does not apply.
notice.location: Type the area and city, then drop a pin on the map exactly where the property is. The map opens on your current location — search a place or tap anywhere to move the pin.
notice.amenities: Click a card to select or remove an amenity. At least one amenity is required before the listing can be submitted for review.
notice.living: These fields power the Gilgit Living Score. Use the real condition of the property—unknown is better than guessing.
notice.images: Upload at least three clear JPG or PNG photos. Upload one image at a time and keep every image smaller than 1 MB. The first uploaded image becomes the initial cover automatically.
notice.rooms: Add each kind of room you offer. Guests book a room type for their dates, and the number of rooms you enter is what stops double bookings.

field.title: Property title
field.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the condition, surroundings, nearby places and the kind of renter this property suits.
field.typeHint: Choose the option that best describes what the renter will actually occupy.
field.rentHint: Amount charged each month, for example 45000.
field.depositHint: One-time refundable deposit. Enter 0 if no deposit is required.
field.availableFromHint: The earliest date a renter can move in.
field.negotiableText: Turn this on only if you are willing to discuss the listed monthly rent.
field.minimumStayHint: Minimum number of months the renter must stay (1–120).
field.bedroomsHint: Number of bedrooms included in the rental.
field.bathroomsHint: Number of bathrooms available to the renter.
field.floorHint: Example: 1 for first floor. Leave empty if it does not apply.
field.totalAreaHint: Enter the size, then choose its unit.
field.areaUnitHint: Unit used for the total property area.
field.furnishingHint: Choose the condition in which the property will be handed over.
field.maxOccupantsHint: Highest number of people you allow to live in the property.
field.areaHint: Example: Jutial, Danyore, Konodas or another local area.
field.streetHint: Street, road or block information if available.
field.cityHint: Defaults to Gilgit but can be changed if the property is elsewhere in the supported area.
field.landmarkHint: A well-known nearby place that helps renters recognize the location.
field.waterHint: Rate the normal reliability of running water at the property.
field.roadHint: Rate how easily renters can normally reach the property by road.
field.washroomsHint: Enter 0 if the shop has none.
field.shopAreaHint: Required for shops. Shopkeepers compare shops mainly by floor area.
